versions.content: {DRAFT} If Time Validation is enab led for a Time Base (refer to SWS_StbM_00464 , SWS_StbM_00465 ), upon invocation of StbM_<bus>SetMasterTimingData() the StbM shall copy the content of the structure, which is passed by pa rameter measureDataPtr , to the next free block <bus>MasterTimingData of the Timesync Master Timing Record Table ( Table 4 ) of that Time Base.

If Time Validation is enabled for a Time Base (refer to SWS_StbM_00464 , SWS_StbM_00465 ), upon invocation of StbM_<bus>SetMasterTimingData() the StbM sh all copy the content of the structure, which is passed by parameter measureDataPtr , to the next free block <bus>MasterTimingData of the Time Master Validation Record Table ( Table 4 ) of that Time Base.

If Time Validation is enabled for a Time Base (refer to SWS_StbM_00464 , SWS_StbM_00465 ), upon invocation of StbM_<bus>SetMasterTimingData() the StbM sh all copy the content of the structure, which is passed by parameter measureDataPtr , to the next free block <bus>MasterTimingData of the Time Master Validation Record Table ( Table 4 ) of that Time Base.
